reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Snow Boots Rack 013
materials.text: After playing in snow, take boots off on the black mat. Put each pair together on the low rack. Wet gloves go on the drying rail. Keep indoor shoes in the clean area. Do not put boots by the hot heater. The teacher checks names before we go home.

questions.prompt: A friend walks into the clean area in snowy boots. You say, "____"
options: Take your boots off on the black mat.
questions.explanation: A黑垫脱雪靴再入净区；B踩室内鞋、C放雪到架都非步骤。

questions.prompt: A friend leaves one boot on each side of the room. You say, "____"
options: Put your pair together on the low rack.
Put both boots in the clean shoe area.
questions.explanation: B成双低架；A分散相反；C净区留室内鞋非雪靴。

questions.prompt: A friend puts wet gloves inside a boot. You say, "____"
options: Hang them on the drying rail.
questions.explanation: C湿手套上晾杆；A靴内、B加热器均不是指定晾处。

questions.prompt: A friend wants boots to dry beside the hot heater. You say, "____"
options: Keep the boots away from the heater.
Put them closer to the heater.
Put the heater inside a boot.
questions.explanation: A靴不放热器旁；B靠近相反；C热器不能按此收纳也非要求。

questions.prompt: A friend grabs boots before the name check. You say, "____"
options: Wait for the teacher to check names.
questions.explanation: B离校前教师核名；A任取、C掩名均违核对流程。

units.title: 机器人展示台的电源规则

materials.title: Class Robot Power 013
materials.text: Our toy robot uses a battery pack. The teacher plugs it in. Keep hands away while it charges. A red light means wait. A green light means ready. Ask the teacher before moving the robot. Put the spare remote in the grey box, not in the robot’s mouth.

questions.prompt: A friend wants to plug in the battery pack. You say, "____"
options: Use the robot’s mouth as a plug.
questions.explanation: A接电由教师；B嘴不是插座；C拉线非正确步骤。

questions.prompt: The red light is on. A friend wants to start. You say, "____"
options: Wait; the red light means wait.
Hide the light with your hand.
questions.explanation: B红灯等；A把红绿含义交换；C遮灯不能改变状态。

questions.prompt: The light turns green. A friend asks what it means. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C绿灯ready；A无电、B回家非信号含义。

questions.prompt: A friend lifts the robot to another table. You say, "____"
options: Ask the teacher before you move it.
questions.explanation: A移动前先问；B不问违规则；C书包非指定展示位置。

questions.prompt: A friend pushes the spare remote into the robot’s mouth. You say, "____"
options: Put the spare remote in the grey box.
questions.explanation: B备用遥控器灰盒；A嘴内明禁；C水中非存处。

materials.title: Butterfly Open Window 013
materials.text: A butterfly flies into our classroom. It lands on the tall cupboard. We stop our game and watch it quietly. Our teacher opens the window wide. She closes the classroom door so the butterfly will not fly into the hall. We stand away from the window. After a minute, it flies outside. We do not catch it in a jar.

questions.prompt: The butterfly lands on a low desk.
questions.explanation: B正确：落在tall cupboard；A换成矮桌。

questions.prompt: The children watch quietly.
questions.explanation: A正确：watch quietly直接给出；B否认行为。

questions.prompt: The teacher opens the classroom door wide.
questions.explanation: B正确：开窗、关门；A混淆开闭对象。

questions.prompt: The children stand away from the window.
questions.explanation: A正确：stand away明确；B否认让路动作。

questions.prompt: The butterfly leaves without being caught in a jar.
questions.explanation: A正确：飞出且do not catch in jar；B否认结局。

materials.title: Postcard Stamp Space 013
materials.text: I make a postcard for my uncle. I draw a bus on the front. On the back, I write about our school trip. Dad helps me write the address on the right. I leave a space above it for a stamp. My little sister wants to put a star sticker there. I give her the front corner instead. The stamp goes in its empty space, and we post the card after lunch.

questions.prompt: The writer draws a bus on the front.
questions.explanation: A正确：bus on front；B否认图画位置。

questions.prompt: Dad writes about the school trip for the writer.
questions.explanation: B正确：作者写游记，爸爸帮地址；A交换两人分工。

questions.prompt: The address is on the right side of the back.
questions.explanation: A正确：背面write address on right；B否认排版。

questions.prompt: The star sticker fills the space kept for the stamp.
questions.explanation: B正确：妹妹贴纸转到正面角，邮票位保留；A把最初想法当行动。

questions.prompt: They post the card after lunch.
questions.explanation: A正确：after lunch寄出；B与时间相反。

units.title: 音乐会座位卡的重新摆放

materials.title: Concert Seat Cards 013
materials.text: The school hall has seats for a small concert. Each row has a letter, and each seat has a number. A teacher puts the cards out before visitors arrive. She leaves two spaces near the aisle for wheelchair users. No chair should stand in those spaces. A helper sees the gaps and tries to fill them with spare chairs. The teacher explains the plan and adds clear signs. Visitors keep their tickets until they find their seats. The concert begins at six, but the doors open at half past five.

questions.prompt: What identifies a row?
questions.explanation: A排用字母；B鞋数、C票价非排标。

questions.prompt: Why are two spaces near the aisle left clear?
questions.explanation: B为轮椅空间；A藏椅、C食物桌均非用途。

questions.prompt: What does the helper misunderstand?
questions.explanation: C误把预留空间当缺椅；A日期、B幕色无关。

questions.prompt: Why do visitors keep their tickets until seated?
options: The tickets help them find their seats.
The tickets are used as instruments.
questions.explanation: A票含位号用于找座；B食票、C乐器不合实际用途。

questions.prompt: When may visitors first enter the hall?
questions.explanation: B5:30开门；C6点开演非最早入；A6:30晚于演出开始。

materials.title: Pencil Shavings Bins 013
materials.text: Our class uses a desk sharpener. A small clear box catches the shavings. On Monday, the box is full and the sharpener stops working well. We do not push pencils harder. The teacher shows us how to remove the box and empty it into the right bin. We keep paper scraps in a different bin. Then the teacher fits the clear box back before anyone uses the sharpener again. A picture label on the box reminds us not to sharpen without it.

questions.prompt: A clear box catches the pencil shavings.
questions.explanation: A正确：clear box catches shavings；B否认部件用途。

questions.prompt: The class solves the problem by pushing pencils harder.
questions.explanation: B正确：do not push harder；A把被禁止做法当解决方法。

questions.prompt: Paper scraps and pencil shavings go in the same bin.
questions.explanation: B正确：paper scraps different bin；A把不同容器说相同。

questions.prompt: The clear box is put back before the sharpener is used again.
questions.explanation: A正确：fits back before use；B否认先后要求。

questions.prompt: The label reminds users to sharpen only with the collection box attached.
questions.explanation: A正确：not sharpen without it即需盒装好；B否认标签规则。

units.title: 义卖布展前的五个求助

materials.title: Fair Display Helper Talk 013
materials.text:
Before the school fair, helpers ask the organiser practical questions. Match each with the best reply. Use each reply once.
A. On the covered terrace, away from the open stairs.
B. Because the display must be ready before visitors arrive.
C. You can help fold the labels at a seated table.
D. At ten to nine on Saturday morning.
E. Please ask a helper to carry it with you.

questions.prompt: Where should we put the finished display boards?
options: On the covered terrace, away from the open stairs.
Because the display must be ready before visitors arrive.
You can help fold the labels at a seated table.
At ten to nine on Saturday morning.
Please ask a helper to carry it with you.
questions.explanation: A回答有顶露台且避楼梯的放置地点；B原因、C坐着任务、D时间、E搬运建议均不直接给目的地。

questions.prompt: Why are helpers arriving earlier than the public?
options: On the covered terrace, away from the open stairs.
Because the display must be ready before visitors arrive.
You can help fold the labels at a seated table.
At ten to nine on Saturday morning.
Please ask a helper to carry it with you.
questions.explanation: B说明开门前布好展的原因；A地点、C可做任务、D具体时间、E搬运方式都不答Why。

questions.prompt: I cannot stand for long. What job can I do?
options: On the covered terrace, away from the open stairs.
Because the display must be ready before visitors arrive.
You can help fold the labels at a seated table.
At ten to nine on Saturday morning.
Please ask a helper to carry it with you.
questions.explanation: C提供可坐着折标签的适合任务；A地点、B原因、D到场时间、E抬重物协助不解决久站限制。

questions.prompt: What time should helpers meet?
options: On the covered terrace, away from the open stairs.
Because the display must be ready before visitors arrive.
You can help fold the labels at a seated table.
At ten to nine on Saturday morning.
Please ask a helper to carry it with you.
questions.explanation: D周六8:50为会合时刻；A位置、B目的、C任务、E帮助方式非时间。

questions.prompt: This board is too heavy for me. What should I do?
options: On the covered terrace, away from the open stairs.
Because the display must be ready before visitors arrive.
You can help fold the labels at a seated table.
At ten to nine on Saturday morning.
Please ask a helper to carry it with you.
questions.explanation: E找同伴合搬回应太重困难；A放处不直接解决搬不起；B准备原因、C其他任务、D时刻均不答此求助。

units.title: 图书馆地球仪的操作牌

materials.title: Library Globe Notice 013
materials.text:
Globe corner: please read before use
This globe shows country borders as they were when it was printed in 2005. Some names and borders have changed. It is useful for finding oceans and large land areas, but use the current atlas beside it for today’s country information. Turn the globe slowly by holding the frame. Do not pull the small flags stuck beside it; they are part of a pupil display, not handles. Two visitors may use the corner at a time. A librarian can bring a larger-print atlas on request. Please leave both the globe and atlas at this table.

questions.prompt: What should readers check in the current atlas?
questions.explanation: B现今国名边界需新地图册；A价格、C拆框、D地址非用途。

questions.prompt: Why might the globe’s country information be outdated?
questions.explanation: C印于2005且部分变化；A旁有现图册；B材料无此陈述；D不是国界不变断言。

questions.prompt: How should visitors turn the globe?
options: By pushing it off the table.
questions.explanation: A持框慢转；B旗非把手；C推落、D户外均非操作。

questions.prompt: How many visitors may use the corner at once?
questions.explanation: D每次两人；A五、B不限、C十均不符。

questions.prompt: What help is available for someone needing larger print?
options: A larger-print atlas from a librarian.
A free globe to take home.
questions.explanation: B可请求馆员拿大字图册；A旗不助读；C地球仪不得带走；D私址未提供。

materials.title: Archived Photo Captions 013
materials.text:
The history club found a photograph labelled "The school garden, 1988." It showed pupils beside young trees. The club wanted to use it in an anniversary display. A retired teacher recognised a building in the background and said it had not opened until 1991. This made the written date doubtful.
Pupils checked a box of school newsletters. They found a similar tree-planting photograph in a 1993 issue, but the clothes and positions were different. It could show another event rather than prove the date of the first photograph. They also asked the archive volunteer to check the original envelope. It had no date.
The club displayed the photograph with a careful caption: "Garden planting event, date not confirmed." A note described the conflict between the old label and the building’s opening date. The pupils invited visitors with further evidence to contact the archive. They did not replace one uncertain date with another just because it seemed likely.

questions.prompt: Why was the date 1988 questioned?
options: A background building opened after that year.
questions.explanation: B背景楼1991才开，冲突1988；A叶子、C无学生均不符；D有校刊。

questions.prompt: What did the 1993 newsletter establish?
options: The first photograph was definitely from 1993.
All school tree events happened only once.
A similar event was photographed, but it might be different.
questions.explanation: C服饰站位不同，可能另一活动；A不能确证原照日期；B没有仅一次；D1980无据。

questions.prompt: What date did the original envelope provide?
questions.explanation: A信封无日期；B旧照片标签非信封；C为建筑启用年；D为校刊年。

questions.prompt: How did the final caption handle the uncertainty?
options: It stated that the date was not confirmed.
questions.explanation: D明确date not confirmed并解释冲突；A未藏；B未确称1993；C仍展示。

questions.prompt: Why were visitors invited to contact the archive?
options: To vote on a date without evidence.
questions.explanation: B征集更多证据；A买楼、C无证投票、D秘密删均非目的。

units.title: 阅读挑战里页数的解释

materials.title: Reading Pages Challenge 013
materials.text:
The library’s reading challenge first counted pages. Pupils wrote the title and number of pages they had read each week. One pupil finished a large-print book with wide margins and gained more page points than a classmate reading the same story in a small edition. The story was equally long, but the page layouts were different.
The librarian did not accuse either pupil of cheating. Both had followed the rule. Instead, she changed the next round. Pupils would record reading time and write a short note about something they understood. The old page totals remained as records of that round, with an explanation of their limits. The new method still could not measure every part of reading, but it gave pupils more than one way to show their effort.

questions.prompt: The first round awarded points based on pages read.
questions.explanation: A正确：first counted pages；B否认初始规则。

questions.prompt: Different editions of the same story could produce different page totals.
questions.explanation: A正确：大字宽边与小版同故事但页数点不同；B否认版式影响。

questions.prompt: The librarian said the two pupils had deliberately cheated.
questions.explanation: B正确：did not accuse，both followed rule；A把规则局限变成学生作弊。

questions.prompt: The next round included time and a short note about understanding.
questions.explanation: A正确：reading time加理解短记；B否认新方法两项。

questions.prompt: The librarian claimed that the new method measured every aspect of reading perfectly.
questions.explanation: B正确：still could not measure every part；A把改进夸成全面完美。
